description: First-version design for interpretable R-centered semantic concepts and relations. This schema does not define pathway rules or semantic graph construction.

RBin.description: An interpretable resistance reporting or magnitude category derived from DeviceRecord attributes.

missing_R.label: Missing resistance
missing_R.description: The device record does not report internal resistance.

low_R.label: Low resistance
low_R.description: The device record is assigned to the established low-resistance bin.

high_R.label: High resistance
high_R.description: The device record is assigned to the established high-resistance bin.

PowerBin.description: An interpretable power reporting or performance category derived from DeviceRecord attributes.

high_power.label: High power
high_power.description: The device record meets the established high-power criterion.

non_high_power.label: Non-high power
non_high_power.description: The device record reports power but does not meet the high-power criterion.

missing_power.label: Missing power
missing_power.description: The device record does not report or support an estimated power value.

Pathway.description: A manually defined, physics-informed physical pathway hypothesis for later device-context reasoning.

connected_pore_ion_transport_pathway.label: Connected-pore ion transport pathway
connected_pore_ion_transport_pathway.description: Describes ion transport through connected porous structures that may support lower resistance.

hydrated_network_ionic_conduction_pathwa.label: Hydrated-network ionic conduction pathway
hydrated_network_ionic_conduction_pathwa.description: Describes ionic conduction through a continuous hydrated material network.

biomass_fiber_capillary_pathway.label: Biomass-fiber capillary pathway
biomass_fiber_capillary_pathway.description: Describes capillary water and ion transport through aligned or connected biomass fibers.

film_based_ion_concentration_gradient_pa.label: Film-based ion concentration gradient pathway
film_based_ion_concentration_gradient_pa.description: Describes ion concentration gradient behavior in film-based device structures.

WarningFlag.description: An interpretable warning attached to a device during later device-context reasoning.

electrochemical_control_needed_warning.label: Electrochemical control needed warning
electrochemical_control_needed_warning.description: Available context indicates that electrochemical controls are needed to assess possible contributions without implying that confounding has been demonstrated.

incomplete_reporting_warning.label: Incomplete reporting warning
incomplete_reporting_warning.description: Key reporting items needed for interpretation are incomplete.

DesignVariable.description: A controllable or characterizable variable relevant to R-centered pathway design.

pore_connectivity.label: Pore connectivity
pore_connectivity.description: Connectivity of pores available for water and ion transport.

hydrated_pathway_continuity.label: Hydrated pathway continuity
hydrated_pathway_continuity.description: Continuity of hydrated domains available for ionic conduction.

ionic_conductivity.label: Ionic conductivity
ionic_conductivity.description: Ionic conductivity of the active transport medium.

film_thickness.label: Film thickness
film_thickness.description: Thickness of the active film or transport layer.

electrolyte_concentration.label: Electrolyte concentration
electrolyte_concentration.description: Concentration of the electrolyte or mobile-ion source.

electrode_symmetry_control.label: Electrode symmetry control
electrode_symmetry_control.description: Control or matching of electrode materials and geometry.

ReportingItem.description: A measurement or experimental detail needed for reproducible interpretation.

internal_resistance.label: Internal resistance
internal_resistance.description: Reported internal resistance or equivalent resistance measurement.

power_density.label: Power density
power_density.description: Reported or reproducibly estimated power density.

device_area.label: Device area
device_area.description: Active or normalized device area used for performance reporting.

film_thickness.label: Film thickness
film_thickness.description: Thickness of the active film or transport layer.

electrode_spacing.label: Electrode spacing
electrode_spacing.description: Distance between electrodes in the tested device.

humidity.label: Humidity
humidity.description: Relative humidity or equivalent environmental water-activity condition.

electrolyte_identity.label: Electrolyte identity
electrolyte_identity.description: Identity and composition of the electrolyte.

electrode_symmetry.label: Electrode symmetry
electrode_symmetry.description: Whether electrode materials and relevant geometry are symmetric.

stability_time.label: Stability time
stability_time.description: Duration and conditions of output stability testing.

control_experiments.label: Control experiments
control_experiments.description: Controls used to distinguish hydrovoltaic output from confounding effects.

device_has_r_bin.description: Associates a device record with its derived resistance bin.

device_has_power_bin.description: Associates a device record with its derived power bin.

device_activates_pathway.description: Associates a device context with a pathway selected by later manually defined rules.

device_has_warning_flag.description: Associates a device context with a warning emitted by later manually defined rules.

pathway_targets_r_bin.description: Identifies the resistance regime addressed by a pathway.

pathway_targets_power_bin.description: Identifies the power regime addressed by a pathway.

pathway_uses_design_variable.description: Identifies a design variable relevant to a pathway.

pathway_has_warning_flag.description: Identifies a warning that may qualify pathway interpretation.

pathway_requires_reporting_item.description: Identifies information required to assess or report a pathway.
